newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev quietly ends flat, cbank seen in mkt.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev quietly ends flat, cbank seen in mkt.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 217.00/50 per dollar, little changed from morning levels after idling in a narrow range amid a lacklustre interbank forex trade, dealers said.
"Foreign currency demand was very low, and trade was rather thin with the lev idling near 217," one dealer said.
The central bank was the main foreign currency buyer, purchasing dollars at 217.00/50 levs, dealers said.
Central bank officials declined comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
